relationships.subject: IL-34
relationships.evidence_quote: The results revealed that IL-34 produced by Schwann cells targets macrophage CSF1R receptors

relationships.subject: Paeonol
relationships.evidence_quote: Paeonol reduced IL-34 production by Schwann cells induced with LPS.

relationships.subject: Paeonol
relationships.evidence_quote: Paeonol decreased the expression levels of IL-34, CSF1R, phosphorylated ERK (p-ERK), phosphorylated NF-κB (p-NF-κB), and components of the NLRP3 inflammasome in the dorsal root ganglia of CCI rats.

relationships.subject: Paeonol
relationships.evidence_quote: Comparative analysis of CCI rat sera revealed notably decreased levels of IL-6, PGE2, IL-1β, TNF-α, SP, and CCL2 in ibuprofen- and Paeonol-treated groups compared to the CCI group

key_findings: After nerve injury Schwann cells secrete IL-34 acting on macrophage CSF1R; Paeonol reduces this and DRG NLRP3 inflammasome components in CCI rats.
